description: This file defines the 'NationalityService' class, which provides various methods for managing Nationality entities, such as retrieving lists, counts, saving, and deleting nationalities within an HRM system.

classes.name: NationalityService
classes.description: A service class that provides business logic for managing Nationality entities, including CRUD operations and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: getNationalityDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the NationalityDao instance used for database operations.

methods.name: setNationalityDao
methods.description: Sets the NationalityDao instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: getNationalityList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of nationalities based on search parameters.

methods.name: getNationalityCount
methods.description: Returns the count of nationalities matching the search criteria.

methods.name: saveNationality
methods.description: Persists a Nationality entity to the database.

methods.name: getNationalityById
methods.description: Fetches a Nationality entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getNationalityByName
methods.description: Fetches a Nationality entity by its name.

methods.name: deleteNationalities
methods.description: Deletes multiple Nationality entities based on provided IDs.

methods.name: isExistingNationalityName
methods.description: Checks if a nationality with the given name already exists.

methods.name: getNationalityArray
methods.description: Retrieves an array of all nationalities normalized into an array of models.
